# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zbOM_yF7pJvFwsJeQcLub-px80fI0nl5PFG3gFjfTFc/edit?gid=861356368#gid=861356368" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "emergentes") 

fb <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("Acro","Limitaciones","Disponiblidad de intercambio"))%>% 
drop_na()

str(fb)
```

```{r}


fb <- fb %>%
  rename(Disponibilidad_intercambio = `Disponiblidad de intercambio`)

crear_banner <- function(texto, color_fondo) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = color_fondo) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = texto, color = "white",
             fontface = "bold", size = 3.6, lineheight = 0.95) +
    xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void()
}

# Panel 1 

color_A <- "#1f3d7a"

fb_long <- fb %>%
  separate_rows(Limitaciones, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(Limitaciones = str_trim(Limitaciones))

orden_A <- fb_long %>% count(Limitaciones, sort = TRUE) %>% pull(Limitaciones)
n_A <- length(orden_A)
angulos_A <- tibble(
  Limitaciones = orden_A,
  angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_A + 1)[1:n_A]
)

conteo_A <- fb_long %>%
  count(Limitaciones, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(angulos_A, by = "Limitaciones") %>%
  arrange(angle)

conteo_A_closed <- bind_rows(conteo_A, conteo_A[1, ])

conteo_A <- conteo_A %>%
  mutate(n_label = n - 0.42)   

radar_A <- ggplot(conteo_A_closed, aes(x = angle, y = n)) +
  geom_polygon(fill = color_A, alpha = 0.1, 
               color = color_A, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = color_A, size = 2.2) +
  geom_text(data = conteo_A,
            aes(x = angle, y = n_label, label = n),
            color = color_A,
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = angulos_A$angle,
    labels = angulos_A$Limitaciones,
    limits = c(0, 2*pi)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(conteo_A$n)*1.2)
  ) +
  coord_polar(start = 0, clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 7,
      face = "bold",
      color = "grey10"
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(40, 80, 40, 80)
  )

banner_A <- crear_banner("A. Main Challenges Limiting\nConservation and Use of Orphan Crops", color_A)

panel_A <- banner_A / radar_A + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 8))

panel_A
# Panel 2 


color_B <- "#2e7d32"

conteo_B <- fb %>%
  count(Disponibilidad_intercambio, name = "n") %>%
  drop_na(Disponibilidad_intercambio)

n_B <- nrow(conteo_B)
angulos_B <- tibble(
  Disponibilidad_intercambio = conteo_B$Disponibilidad_intercambio,
  angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_B + 1)[1:n_B]
)

conteo_B <- conteo_B %>% left_join(angulos_B, by = "Disponibilidad_intercambio") %>% arrange(angle)
conteo_B_closed <- bind_rows(conteo_B, conteo_B[1, ])

radar_B <- ggplot(conteo_B_closed, aes(x = angle, y = n)) +
  geom_polygon(fill = color_B, alpha = 0.25, color = color_B, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = color_B, size = 2.2) +
  geom_text(data = conteo_B, aes(label = n),
            vjust = -1.1, fontface = "bold", color = color_B, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = angulos_B$angle, labels = angulos_B$Disponibilidad_intercambio, limits = c(0, 2 * pi)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(conteo_B$n) * 1.2)) +
  coord_polar(start = 0) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "grey20")
  )

banner_B <- crear_banner("B. Availability of Genetic Material\n for Exchange", color_B)

panel_B <- banner_B / radar_B + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 8))

(panel_A | panel_B) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Challenges and Availability Identified by Respondents",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))
  )

ggsave("manuscript/Figuue_2.png", width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

datos <- read_csv("files/datos_unidos.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

str(datos)

anual <- datos %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),
    Citations = sum(`Cited by`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year)

factor <- max(anual$Publications) / max(anual$Citations)

y_max <- ceiling(max(anual$Publications) / 5) * 5 + 5
y_breaks <- seq(0, y_max, by = 5)

ggplot(anual, aes(x = Year)) +
  
  geom_col(
    aes(y = Publications, fill = "Publications"),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Citations * factor, colour = "Citations"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Citations * factor, colour = "Citations"),
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Publications" = "#9fd3f2")
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Citations" = "#b22222")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max),
    breaks = y_breaks,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    name = "Publications",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~./factor,
      name = "Citations",
      breaks = y_breaks / factor,
      labels = function(x) round(x)
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(anual$Year), max(anual$Year), by = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(x = "Year") +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    colour = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )
```


```{r}
#========================================================
# LIBRERÍAS
#========================================================

library(bibliometrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)

#========================================================
# IMPORTAR LA BASE DE DATOS
#========================================================

M <- convert2df(
  file = "files/datos_unidos.csv",
  dbsource = "scopus",
  format = "csv"
)

#========================================================
# EXTRAER TODOS LOS AUTORES DE LA BASE DE DATOS
#========================================================

autores_totales <- M %>%
  separate_rows(AU, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(AU = str_trim(AU)) %>%
  distinct(AU)

# Visualizar los primeros autores
head(autores_totales, 50)

#========================================================
# BUSCAR LOS AUTORES DEL CLÚSTER POR APELLIDO
#========================================================

cluster <- M %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Maughan", AU, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Jellen", AU, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Fairbanks", AU, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Coleman", AU, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Stevens", AU, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Bonifacio", AU, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

#========================================================
# COMPROBAR CUÁNTOS DOCUMENTOS SE ENCONTRARON
#========================================================

nrow(cluster)

#========================================================
# ELIMINAR DOCUMENTOS DUPLICADOS
#========================================================

cluster <- cluster %>%
  distinct(TI, .keep_all = TRUE)

#========================================================
# EXTRAER LAS PUBLICACIONES DEL CLÚSTER
#========================================================

publicaciones <- cluster %>%
  select(
    TI,     # Título
    AU,     # Autores
    PY,     # Año
    SO,     # Revista
    TC,     # Citas
    DE,     # Palabras clave
    AB      # Resumen
  )

# Ver las publicaciones encontradas
publicaciones

#========================================================
# PALABRAS CLAVE MÁS FRECUENTES DEL CLÚSTER
#========================================================

keywords <- cluster %>%
  separate_rows(DE, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(DE = str_trim(DE)) %>%
  filter(DE != "") %>%
  count(DE, sort = TRUE)

# Mostrar las 30 palabras clave más frecuentes
head(keywords, 30)

#========================================================
# EXPORTAR LOS RESULTADOS A EXCEL
#========================================================

write_xlsx(
  list(
    Publicaciones = publicaciones,
    Keywords = keywords
  ),
  path = "Cluster_autores.xlsx"
)

#========================================================
# EXPORTAR EN CSV (OPCIONAL)
#========================================================

write.csv(
  publicaciones,
  "Publicaciones_cluster.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  keywords,
  "Keywords_cluster.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

#========================================================
# MOSTRAR LOS TÍTULOS DE LOS ARTÍCULOS
#========================================================

publicaciones$TI
```
